name: [BaseApp] Logger-Backed Test Monitoring
description: Updated the test framework to derive test config from the integrated runtime config, use the main logger data_map as the monitoring channel, publish lightweight runtime state from the app for post-run checks, and persist explicit failing test ids, failure counts, and traceback context in test results.

name: [BaseApp] Built-In Test Framework
description: Added a config-driven test framework with prep, live, and post phases, a dedicated PASS/NOTE/FAIL test logger, a thread-safe runtime monitor, and persisted test artifacts under the standard output pipeline.

name: [BaseApp] Split Output Artifacts
description: Added output split support for single-layer and multi-layer dict outputs, including dotted source resolution and per-key artifact storage using either nested folders plus file or format-based leaf filenames.

name: [BaseApp] Nested HTML Table Widths
description: Updated the dataset_table template so nested tables render at content width for better readability of small complex values while the top-level output table remains full width.

name: [BaseApp] HTML Item Enumeration Column
description: Updated HtmlDoc to add a leading item enumeration column to top-level and nested rendered tables.

name: [BaseApp] HTML Value Type Column
description: Updated HtmlDoc dict rendering to add a type column after key, including item counts for list values and key counts for dict values.

name: [BaseApp] Converter Logging Hook
description: Updated DataFrameConverter to use an injectable logging function instead of direct print calls, defaulting to print when verbose mode is enabled.

name: [BaseApp] Step Target Driven Process Output
description: Updated DataFrameConverter so df-scope process conversions run without a conversion-level target and the step target controls where the final result is stored on results.

name: [BaseApp] Config Driven DataFrame Processing
description: Added config.process support so sequential DataFrameConverter steps can transform results data, including a default step that concatenates message_codes into message_codes_df.

name: [BaseApp] Unified Input File Map Loading
description: Refactored DataLoader to build a key:path map first and run one concurrent loading flow for single files and folders alike, using basenames for direct file inputs and relative paths for folder inputs.

name: [BaseApp] Single File Input Basename Keys
description: Updated single-file config.input loading to keep results keyed by file basename, for example updates.base.json, instead of using the dummy '.' key or returning the payload directly.

name: [BaseApp] Single File Input Shape Fix
description: Kept updates/base.json as a config.input source and removed the dummy '.' key from single-file loads by keying file results explicitly instead.

name: [BaseApp] Recursive JSON Field Materialization
description: Updated output serialization to recursively parse JSON-like string fields (including DataFrame rows) into native objects and added parse diagnostics (BASE011/BASEW11).

name: [BaseApp] Message Codes And Project-Dir Pathing
description: Switched default message dictionary paths to docs/message_codes and aligned relative path resolution to the app/project directory for logger message lookup and config.input DataLoader sources.

name: [BaseApp] Generic Input Data Loader
description: Added load_data flow to process all config.input entries where load=true, storing each dataset under results.{target} with file and folder path support.

name: [BaseApp] Script Message Lookup Paths
description: Fixed instantiate and pullbase messages_dir resolution to load message CSVs from config-relative docs/messages so message code text/type lookup works.

name: [BaseApp] Pullbase Logger Init Fallback
description: Added explicit console output when pullbase logger initialization fails, preventing silent logging disablement.

name: [BaseApp] Trackit Runtime Orchestration
description: Introduced Config runtime loader, renamed decorator to trackit, and updated run() to initialize config/logger then log execute tracking output with function, result, and metrics.duration_seconds.

name: [BaseApp] Run Timeit Decorator
description: Added a reusable timeit decorator and applied it to run() so total runtime is logged with message code BASE005.

name: [BaseApp] Logger Data Column
description: Updated Logger.log signature to use data payload and store caller key:value metadata in a single CSV data column instead of dynamic parsed columns.

name: [BaseApp] Logger Dynamic Fields
description: Added Logger.log fields support so caller-supplied key:value data is mapped to dynamic CSV columns and populated only on relevant rows.

name: [BaseApp] Pullbase Local App Logs
description: Updated pullbase logging to use local app identity and output path C:/data/{local_app}/{date}/basepulls/{local_app}_{timestamp}.(csv|html).

name: [BaseApp] Instantiate Base Config Only
description: Updated instantiate runtime config loading to use only base.json (no app.json override) for path and logging resolution.

name: [BaseApp] Instantiate Fixed Log Path
description: Updated instantiate logging output to C:/data/BaseApp/instantiations/{date}/{target_app}_{timestamp}.csv and matching HTML path.

name: [BaseApp] Instantiate Pullbase Logging
description: Added CSV+HTML logging to instantiate (base logs_path/instantiations, {target_app}_{timestamp}) and pullbase (app logs_path/basepulls, {base_app}_{timestamp}).

name: [BaseApp] Manifest Folder Source Sync
description: Added support for manifest entries whose source is a folder; instantiate and pullbase now sync all files recursively with optional target folder mapping.

name: [BaseApp] Key Driven Manifest Folder
description: Updated instantiate and pullbase to consume all JSON files from docs/manifests and apply behavior by key: instantiate uses once+pull, pullbase uses pull.

name: [BaseApp] Manifest Source Target Schema
description: Updated instantiate and pullbase manifest parsing to use section lists of items with required source and optional target defaulting to source.

name: [BaseApp] Scripts And Manifest Dict
description: Moved instantiate and pullbase into scripts/ and updated manifests to dict format with pull and once sections under docs/manifests.

name: [BaseApp] Manifest Location Refactor
description: Moved instantiate and pull manifests to docs/manifests (pull.json and once.json) and updated instantiate.py and pullbase.py to consume the new paths.
